newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE downgrades SCL to CARE BB+ (FD).
newsitem.headline: India's CARE downgrades SCL to CARE BB+ (FD).

text.p: Credit Analysis & Research Ltd.(CARE) has downgraded the rating for the fixed deposit programme of Suri Capital & Leasing Ltd. (SCL) for a limit of 20 million rupees from CARE BBB+(FD) Triple B plus to CARE BB+(FD) Double B plus, CARE said on Thursday.
SCL is a Delhi based NBFC, mainly engaged in leasing and HP financing, CARE said in a statement.
For FY97, SCL reported a decline of 52 percent in total income and an 83 percent drop in net profit, over FY96. Income from leasing was down 52 percent.
